name: ptyper-overhead-typer
description: What the parallel typer spike costs the ordinary serial compiler, and what its one-thread parallel path costs on top: compiles stopped after the typer, every build paired within each fork. `base` against `aa` (the same build in a second class loader) is the noise floor.
Serial overhead: `base` → `guards` → `spike`. Parallel overhead: `spike` → `par1`. xctrace counts the benchmark thread only, so `par1`'s counters miss its worker thread: compare `par1` by time.

variantDescriptions.aa: `base` again in its own class loader: the A/A
variantDescriptions.guards: [retronym/scala#212](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/212) at `fd95c5c1c1`: `Scratch` and `Frame` per thread and completion
variantDescriptions.spike: the parallel typer spike at `b650049602`, without `-Yparallel-typer`
variantDescriptions.par1: `spike` with `-Yparallel-typer -Yparallel-typer-threads:1`: the parallel driver on one worker
